hero.subtitle: Please carefully read the statutory cancellation, modification, and refund regulations governing Jeep Safari, Canter Safari, and stay bookings at Ranthambore Wild Life Tour.

blocks.intro: Rajasthan Forest Department Rules Applicable • Season 2026-2027

items.title: 100% Non-Returnable
items.text: Amounts paid for confirmed Jeep and Canter safaris are completely non-returnable once permits are generated.

items.title: Unconfirmed Fee Return
items.text: If the safari booking is not confirmed due to gate quota exhaustion, advance booking fees are returned.

items.title: Provisional In Nature
items.text: All bookings are subject to modification or cancellation by the Field Director, Ranthambore Tiger Reserve.

items.title: No Rescheduling
items.text: Under no circumstances shall a safari be rescheduled or refunded once allocated by the forest portal.

blocks.title: Core Statutory Notice of Ranthambore Tiger Reserve
blocks.text:
Canter Safari & Jeep Safari: The amounts paid are not returnable. Charges for the Jeep Safari and Canter Safari are not refundable. If the safari booking is not confirmed, the current booking fees will be returned.

Note that all bookings are provisional in nature and are subject to modification or cancellation by the Field Director, Ranthambore Tiger Reserve, without providing a reason. Your acceptance of the terms is implied upon booking.

blocks.heading: 1. Non-Returnable Safari Fees (Jeep & Canter)
blocks.body:
**Canter Safari & Jeep Safari: The amounts paid are not returnable.** Charges for the Jeep Safari and Canter Safari are not refundable under any individual or collective circumstance once processed.

This policy is governed by the statutory framework of the Rajasthan Forest Department. Once safari permits are requested and issued against official government identity documents, permit charges are immediately transferred to forest treasury accounts and cannot be revoked.

blocks.heading: 2. Unconfirmed Booking Return Guarantee
blocks.body:
**If the safari booking is not confirmed, the current booking fees will be returned.**

In rare situations where vehicle quotas for both preferred and alternate zones are completely exhausted on the official government reservation server for your requested date and shift, our booking desk will notify you immediately and return advance fees.

Refunds are processed within 5 to 7 banking days directly to your original payment method.

blocks.heading: 3. Field Director Statutory Authority
blocks.body:
Note that all bookings are provisional in nature and are subject to modification or cancellation by the Field Director, Ranthambore Tiger Reserve, without providing a reason.

Such administrative decisions are rare and typically relate to extreme weather, security VIP protocols, or active big cat movement management.

blocks.heading: 4. Non-Reschedulable & Non-Transferable Bookings
blocks.body: Under no circumstances shall a confirmed safari permit be transferred to another passenger or rescheduled to an alternate date. Permits are locked with passenger ID numbers in the forest server.
